when: after evidence sufficiency, before ANY verification (:endteach one-shot, :learn)
rule: each demonstration is replayed on its start snapshot in a rolled-back transaction. For every FIND with a constraint and every FILTER (aligned by position across the used demonstrations): (1) non-empty in >= 1 demonstration; (2) for each registered contrast of its constraints — STATUS_DROPPED (status removed) and WHO<->RECIPIENT at SELF scope when the ontology allows the sibling for the type — some demonstration where the contrast result differs.
on_failure: status REQUIRE_SECOND_DEMONSTRATION, insufficient='EVIDENCE_VACUOUS: ...' (the demonstration is kept as example 1 on the one-shot path); the teacher is asked for another demonstration with different example values
metrics: EVIDENCE_NONVACUITY_DETECTED (over demonstrations the oracle finds vacuous)
